description: This PHP source file defines the SystemCheckController class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends an abstract Vue controller and implements a public controller interface, responsible for handling system check related HTTP requests, managing configuration access, rendering Vue components with theme variables, and controlling access to the system check screen within the HRM system.

classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the system check page, rendering the Vue component, and managing configuration and theme variables for the system check interface.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the controller; checks whether the system check screen should be shown and sets HTTP 404 response if not.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component and template before rendering.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the system check page, passing relevant context variables to the template.

methods.name: getDefaultThemeVariables
methods.description: Returns an array of theme variables for styling the system check interface.
